turns.text: I fixed `combination_with_replacement_index`, and all 747 tests now pass. The function decided it had used up the element by checking `if y is None`, so a combination containing an actual `None` value stopped early. That gave wrong indexes, and invalid inputs got through without the expected `ValueError`. I added a `done` flag that is set only when the element iterator really runs out (`tmp is None`), and the loop now stops on that flag instead of on the value of `y`.
